resolutions.researcher_notes: The brief classed this current_ref DEAD_LINK, but it is live (verified 200, re-fetched and hand-read directly): Youm7, 2021-12-19, a Ministry of Petroleum infrastructure roundup for Upper Egypt, states verbatim 'ازدواج خط المنيا-أسيوط بطول 140 كم باستثمارات 750 مليون جنيه' ('doubling of the El Minya-Asyut line, 140 km, with investments of 750 million EGP') -- an exact match to Cost=750,000,000 EGP. A second Youm7 article (2024-09-24, a later ministry briefing) also describes 'doubling a 16" line from El Minya to Asyut, 140 km' confirming the project is real and ongoing, but gives no cost figure, so it cannot independently corroborate this specific value -- kept at medium/single-source. Opened both wiki seed citations (the 2024 story and the repeated 2021 story).
